sprint.title: Acme Sprint Report
sprint.summary: The team completed all planned work, released the unified notification service, improved mobile ordering performance, and finished the sprint without a critical production defect.

releases.name: Unified customer notification service
releases.outcome: Consolidated three email and push handlers into one event-driven pipeline.

releases.name: Mobile order summary
releases.outcome: Reduced mobile load time by roughly 40 percent.

releases.name: Reporting read replica
releases.outcome: Improved dashboard query performance by six times.

releases.name: Multi-device authentication fix
releases.outcome: Removed intermittent session drops for users with multiple active devices.

demo.scenario: Follow a simulated order event through email and mobile push delivery, then inspect the redesigned order summary on mobile.
observations: The notification pipeline fanned out to both channels and completed in under two seconds.
The mobile order summary remained responsive across the tested device sizes.
Events arriving within 50 milliseconds were initially deduplicated too aggressively.
A correlation identifier now distinguishes duplicates from legitimate concurrent notifications.
A stale push token is logged and the email channel is re-queued so the customer still receives a notification.

next_sprint.capacity_note: Capacity is reduced by planned time off.
goals: Ship the self-service account settings redesign.
Begin phase one of the analytics data-model refactor.
Close the remaining payments-service technical-debt tickets.
